effects.notes: Each time the owner uses a wood accumulation space, they may afterwards return 4 wood from their own supply onto that same space and receive 2 stone, 1 clay, 1 reed and 1 grain. The wood lands on the space that was just used, so it stays available for later takes (A056 exchange + return_to pattern).

review.notes: Cost: none. Prereq: none. Printed points: 0. Ban: strong. Own-word summary of the third-party wiki effect: after each use of a wood accumulation space, the owner may put 4 wood from their supply back onto that space to gain 2 stone, 1 clay, 1 reed and 1 grain. Space names follow the A056 wood-accumulation triple (forest / copse / grove). Classification (docs/all-cards-classification-final.md, PR #377 source): stage outside, single site: space use / payment plus gain, TR-SITE.
